text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, I called Sakura Laurel to 
the trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...My plans after the Arima Kinen?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, next year's right around the corner, 
after all.

Yeah, next year is right around the 
corner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we're heading to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, it's about time we start 
discussing concrete details, like travel 
dates."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Should I make thorough adjustments in 
Japan before heading over, or plan for a 
longer overseas stay beforehand...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...That's a tough choice.
choice_data_list:
You don't have to decide right this 
second.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will consider it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And that evening, I received a message 
from Sakura Laurel asking if we could talk 
tomorrow afternoon."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Let's go shopping! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I asked Hishiama-chan for advice 
last night. Since she's experienced with 
overseas trips and all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And then she told me, 'Go buy yourself a 
suitcase.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
They told me, "It'll really hit you once 
you start preparing, and you'll be able to 
sort out what you want to do."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And so, shall we go look for travel gear 
for you too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, Sakura Laurel took me 
along to a bustling, crowded mall—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Assuming I pack spare horseshoes, I 
think I'd want a size about this big...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The suitcase Sakura Laurel is looking at 
is smaller than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking a separate suitcase just 
for carry-on luggage aside from this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I figured anything I can procure 
locally isn't necessary. If I use laundry 
services, I can cut down on the amount of 
clothes, too.
choice_data_list: You're really used to this, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I used to go visit my father in France 
once a year back in the day, so I guess 
I'm fairly used to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's best to travel as light as possible 
so you can move around easily. It helps 
you avoid trouble, too."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the logic for traveling might be 
completely different from an expedition, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. An "overseas expedition," huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Before I even knew it, I became 
an Umamusume worthy of a ticket to the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, didn't I?
choice_data_list: Right, you definitely have the ability.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And the legs to endure the race as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Next, let's find something 
for you!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd be best if your suitcase was 
as big as possible, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
This seems different from what I heard 
earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Bigger is always better, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I also have a faint hope that... 
maybe you'd help me out if there's any 
luggage that doesn't fit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I am in trouble, you never fail 
to lend me a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time we finished shopping, it was 
pitch-black outside. I bought hot 
chocolate from the stand outside, getting 
one for Sakura Laurel as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Everywhere you look, it's totally 
Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A year really does fly by in the blink of 
an eye, doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our breaths mingled with the steam from 
our drinks. The two plumes of white 
quickly melted away into the winter sky."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The suitcase is important, but since it's 
a long trip, a travel kit with small 
shampoo bottles is an absolute must!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's get some moisturizing skincare 
products and a light, compact folding 
umbrella too♪
choice_data_list: Didn't you buy a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'll help you pack when the time comes♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hair styling products are a must too! 
You have to be dressed up properly for 
Paris!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, carried along by Sakura Laurel's 
energy, we kept walking through every 
corner of the mall.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...I'll grab this one as well. Hehe...♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Good work today, Trainer. We walked quite 
a lot, didn't we~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry. I got a little carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...This is for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I secretly bought it while you weren't 
looking, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you a present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the box was a cap that felt 
wonderful to the touch. Near the brim, a 
laurel leaf design gleamed brightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. I just wanted you to wear a 
matching "Laurel," that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The language of flowers for laurel is 
'glory and victory.' Let's wear the same 
crown together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—To claim the crown of victory at the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull the hat Sakura Laurel gave me down 
snugly so it won't slip off my head.
choice_data_list:
Let's turn victory from a dream into 
reality.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That moment will be here soon 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe," which had 
been nothing more than a dream two years 
ago, now felt like a clearly defined path 
for the two of them to take.
